title: The UNTHINKABLE is About to Happen to the Stock Market (& Why AI Stocks are Next)
creator: Tom Nash
summary: Tom Nash argues the recent fear-driven selloff — a hot inflation print on Wednesday, the S&P 500 down about 1.1% and ending a six-year streak without a 1% down day, Nasdaq and small caps down about 2% — exposes lack of conviction rather than broken companies. His core claim is that a stock rising 1,000% does not make most holders money: using Palantir's path from $10 to $40, down to $6 for a year, then to about $200, he says most retail investors buy hype and sell bottoms. The fix, in his system, is research, consistency, a system and conviction, built slowly like fitness or learning an instrument. He recaps his Roic Academy top-stocks list — Nvidia up almost 1,500% since October 2020, Palantir up about 1,900%, plus ANET, ASML, Micron, AMD, ARM, Datadog and Bloom Energy — stressing each suffered 20–75% drawdowns on the way. He gives seven checks for a falling stock: revenue growth, expanding margins, lost contracts or clients, rising debt, key executive departures, weak forecasts and new competitors. His worked example is Zeta Global, pitched in May 2026 after a 50% fall since November 2024 and up 92% since, on 30% revenue growth to $1.3 billion, free cash flow up 100% and more cash than debt. His rules: never time the market, double down when the S&P is 10% below its 52-week high or a single name is 20% below, trim at +50/+100/+150%, and check the portfolio at most weekly. The video mainly funnels to a free masterclass on Saturday 24 October at 2pm Eastern, promising his research-system document and a never-before-mentioned bullish pick. No new individual stock calls are made; tickers named are historical examples and system illustrations only.
